Michael Torrisi graduated with his B.S. in [Marine Science program](https://csumb.edu/marinescience/) from [California State University, Monterey Bay](https://csumb.edu/) in May of 2026. His undergraduate research focused on understanding white shark ontogeny and prey interaction along the central California coast.

Contact: mtorrisi@csumb.edu
